name: acetaminophen-500-otc
dose_note: One dose = 2 caplets ('take 2 caplets every 6 hours').

name: alendronate-70mg-tab
dose_note: One 70 mg tablet once weekly (label 2.1); LINNET checks the day it is taken.

name: apap-codeine-300-30
dose_note: One tablet per dose by default; the prescription sets tablets per dose (label: 'Take 1 to 2 tablet every 4 hours'; 'The prescriber must determine the number of tablets per dose').

name: cefdinir-300mg-cap
dose_note: One 300 mg capsule per dose ('300 mg q12h or 600 mg q24h'); the prescription sets capsules per dose.

name: colestipol-1g-tab
dose_note: One dose = 2 g (label starting dose '2 grams once or twice daily').

name: dolutegravir-50mg-tab
dose_note: One 50 mg tablet per dose, once or twice daily ('50 mg: Each tablet contains 50 mg of dolutegravir (as dolutegravir sodium).'; '50 mg once daily' or '50 mg twice daily').

name: ferrous-sulfate-325-otc
display_name: Ferrous sulfate 325 mg tablets (65 mg iron, OTC)
dose_note: One tablet per dose ('Elemental Iron 65 mg (Equivalent to 325 mg of Ferrous Sulfate)'). The label gives no daily count, so none is enforced.

name: levofloxacin-750mg-tab
dose_note: One 750 mg tablet per dose, every 24 hours ('Levofloxacin Tablets USP, 750 mg'; the label's doses are 250 mg, 500 mg or 750 mg every 24 hours).

name: levothyroxine-100mcg
dose_note: One tablet once daily (strength chosen for the demo patient).

name: moxifloxacin-400mg-tab
dose_note: One 400 mg tablet per dose; 'The dose of moxifloxacin is 400 mg (orally) once every 24 hours.'

name: naproxen-sodium-220-otc
dose_note: One dose = 1 caplet ('take 1 caplet every 8 to 12 hours while symptoms last'; 'Naproxen sodium 220 mg (naproxen 200 mg)').

name: nimodipine-30mg-cap
dose_note: One dose = two 30 mg capsules (label: '60 mg (two 30 mg capsules)').

name: rifampin-300mg-cap
dose_note: One dose = 2 capsules (600 mg) by default, the label's adult ceiling ('10 mg/kg, in a single daily administration, not to exceed 600 mg/day'); the dose is by weight, so the prescription sets capsules per dose.

name: sucralfate-1g-tab
dose_note: One 1 g tablet per dose; 'The recommended adult oral dosage for duodenal ulcer is 1 g four times per day on an empty stomach.'

name: tramadol-50mg-tab
dose_note: One 50 mg tablet per dose by default; the prescription sets tablets per dose (label: '50 mg to 100 mg every 4 to 6 hours as needed for pain').

name: tums-es-750
display_name: Tums Chewy Bites ES (calcium carbonate 750 mg)
dose_note: One dose = 2 tablets, the low end of 'chew 2-4 tablets as symptoms occur' (interpreted).
